cypher:
// blast_radius: who breaks if this service fails? (callers of callers, up to $maxHops)
MATCH p = (dep:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(s:Service {uid: $service})
WITH dep, min(length(p)) AS hops, collect(p)[0] AS p
CALL algo.betweenness({nodeLabels: ['Service'], relationshipTypes: ['DEPENDS_ON']}) YIELD node, score
WHERE node = dep
OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(dep)
RETURN dep.uid AS service, dep.name AS name, hops, score AS betweenness, dep.tier AS tier, t.uid AS team, p
ORDER BY betweenness DESC, hops ASC

// critical_services: which services are chokepoints of the dependency graph?
CALL algo.betweenness({nodeLabels: ['Service'], relationshipTypes: ['DEPENDS_ON']}) YIELD node, score
OPTIONAL MATCH (node)<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(caller:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (node)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(callee:Service)
RETURN node.uid AS service, node.name AS name, score AS betweenness,
       count(DISTINCT caller) AS dependents, count(DISTINCT callee) AS dependencies
ORDER BY betweenness DESC
LIMIT $limit

findings.claim: PR #2143 (async Kafka producer in checkout, merged 2 days before the alert) is the most likely cause.
cypher:
// suspect_changes: recent human PRs on the service or anything it depends on
MATCH (newest:PR) WITH max(newest.mergedAt) AS now
MATCH p = (author:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(pr:PR)-[:TOUCHES]->(touched:Service)<-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..2]-(s:Service {uid: $service})
WHERE pr.mergedAt >= now - $sinceDays * 86400000 AND ($includeBots OR NOT pr.isBot)
WITH pr, author, touched, min(length(p)) - 2 AS hops, collect(p)[0] AS p
RETURN pr.uid AS pr, pr.number AS number, pr.title AS title, pr.mergedAt AS mergedAt, author.name AS author,
       pr.isBot AS isBot, touched.uid AS service, hops, pr.filesChanged AS files,
       pr.additions AS additions, pr.deletions AS deletions, pr.url AS url, p
ORDER BY pr.isBot ASC, pr.mergedAt DESC
LIMIT $limit

cypher:
// similar_incidents: vector search over Incident embeddings, then expand to cause, runbook, responders
CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('Incident', 'embedding', $k, vecf32($vec)) YIELD node AS i, score
OPTIONAL MATCH p1 = (i)-[:CAUSED_BY]->(pr:PR)
OPTIONAL MATCH p2 = (i)-[:RESOLVED_BY]->(rb:Runbook)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:AFFECTED]->(s:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:RESPONDED_BY]->(person:Person)
RETURN i.uid AS incident, i.title AS title, score AS distance, s.uid AS service, pr.uid AS causedBy,
       rb.uid AS runbook, collect(DISTINCT person.uid) AS responders, p1, p2
ORDER BY distance ASC

// past_incidents: incidents on the service (or a neighbour) with cause PR and resolving runbook
MATCH (s:Service {uid: $service})
MATCH p = (i:Incident)-[:AFFECTED]->(:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..1]-(s)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:CAUSED_BY]->(pr:PR)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:RESOLVED_BY]->(rb:Runbook)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:RESPONDED_BY]->(person:Person)
RETURN DISTINCT i.uid AS incident, i.title AS title, i.severity AS severity, i.startedAt AS startedAt,
       s.uid AS service, pr.uid AS causedBy, rb.uid AS runbook, rb.steps AS runbookSteps,
       collect(DISTINCT person.uid) AS responders, i.synthetic AS synthetic, i.sessionId AS sessionId, p
ORDER BY startedAt DESC
LIMIT $limit

findings.claim: Maya Okafor (author of #2143, top authorship PageRank on checkout) can fix it; Tomas Lindqvist is on call.
cypher:
// who_knows: PageRank over authorship, weighted by activity on this service; bots excluded
CALL algo.pageRank('Person', 'AUTHORED') YIELD node AS person, score AS rank
WHERE NOT person.isBot
MATCH p = (person)-[:AUTHORED]->(pr:PR)-[:TOUCHES]->(s:Service {uid: $service})
WITH person, rank, count(pr) AS prs, max(pr.mergedAt) AS lastActiveAt, collect(p)[0] AS p
OPTIONAL MATCH (person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
OPTIONAL MATCH (person)-[oc:ON_CALL_FOR]->(:Service {uid: $service})
RETURN person.uid AS person, person.name AS name, rank * prs AS score, prs, t.uid AS team,
       count(oc) > 0 AS onCall, lastActiveAt, p
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT $limit

// on_call: who holds the latest rotation week for this service?
MATCH p = (person:Person)-[r:ON_CALL_FOR]->(s:Service {uid: $service})
WHERE r.weekStartTs <= $at
OPTIONAL MATCH (person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)
RETURN person.uid AS person, person.name AS name, r.weekStart AS weekStart, t.uid AS team, s.uid AS service, p
ORDER BY r.weekStartTs DESC
LIMIT 1

// memory inspector: the session's episode chain with the findings each episode produced
MATCH (s:Session {sessionId: $sessionId})-[:HAS_EPISODE]->(e:Episode)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:PRODUCED]->(f:Finding)
RETURN e, collect(f) AS findings
ORDER BY e.seq

// procedural memory: incidents and runbooks per service
MATCH (i:Incident)-[:AFFECTED]->(s:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:RESOLVED_BY]->(r:Runbook)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:CAUSED_BY]->(pr:PR)
RETURN s.uid AS service, i, r, pr.uid AS causedBy
ORDER BY i.resolvedAt DESC
